# **Unlocking the Flavors of Iloilo with PayMongo’s Seamless Payment Solutions**


*PayMongo is making it easier than ever to savor the flavors of Iloilo! Discover seamless and hassle-free culinary and heritage tours with PayMongo.*


Culinary tours offer a unique window into a city’s history and culture. To meet the rising demand for curated experiences, the Department of Trade and Industry (DTI), in partnership with the Iloilo City MICE Office and as part of the Lungsod Lunsad Project, launched the **Meet and Taste Iloilo City Tours** on December 10, 2024, at Iloilo City Hall.


These immersive tours spotlight Iloilo’s diverse flavors and rich traditions, drawing food lovers and cultural explorers from near and far. Enhancing the overall experience, the city partnered with PayMongo and Mochi Solutions to provide seamless booking, invoicing, and payment processes—ensuring convenience for both tourists and travel agencies.


While Mochi simplifies bookings and invoicing, PayMongo goes beyond payments by offering tools that streamline financial workflows, support cash flow, and enable agencies to manage their finances effortlessly. This collaboration elevates Iloilo as a premier culinary destination, bolstering local businesses and promoting sustainable tourism.


[https://www.mochi.ph/blog/meeting-and-tasting-iloilo-mochi-and-paymongo](https://www.mochi.ph/blog/meeting-and-tasting-iloilo-mochi-and-paymongo?ref=paymongo-blog.ghost.io)


### **Meet and Taste Iloilo City Tours: A Culinary Adventure**


Iloilo City, the Philippines' first UNESCO Creative City of Gastronomy, invites you to embark on a one-of-a-kind adventure! Explore the city's rich food heritage through five curated tours: the "Culinary Heritage Experience," "Food Favorites Adventure," "Sustainable Eats Tour," "Chef's Picks," and "Pasalubong & *Panaderia* Stops."


Each tour offers a unique lens into Iloilo's diverse flavors and cultural traditions, from iconic dishes to hidden gems. PayMongo is happy to be a part of this venture with our convenient and dependable online payment tools. With PayMongo, booking your gastronomic journey has never been easier. Now you can savor every moment and support local businesses at the same time.


### **PayMongo: Empowering Financial Operations in Tourism**


Technology is transforming how we experience the world - and Iloilo City's culinary tours are no exception. By embracing technology, these immersive journeys become more accessible to food enthusiasts everywhere.


PayMongo is key in this transformation, offering secure, efficient, and user-friendly online payment solutions. Guests can quickly book and pay for their culinary adventures, knowing their purchases are safe using global security standards. Meanwhile, travel agencies and tour operators enjoy real-time processing, multiple payment options, streamlined refund procedures, and improved customer trust and satisfaction.


With PayMongo, exploring Iloilo's gastronomic delights is as easy as clicking a button.


### **Using PayMongo for Better Customer Experiences**


PayMongo proudly partners with Mochi Solutions to ensure smooth, hassle-free transactions. Activate PayMongo as your preferred payment gateway directly from your Mochi account! Simply go to Settings, then Payment Portal, select PayMongo, and click "Get Started." You'll be guided through a quick onboarding process.


This integration offers a unified solution, enabling you to manage bookings, accept various payment methods, and[automate invoicing](https://www.mochi.ph/?ref=paymongo-blog.ghost.io) —all from a single platform. The synergy between Mochi and PayMongo ensures flawless operations, minimizes manual work, and delights the customer.


### **Choose PayMongo and elevate your travel business!**


PayMongo is honored to support Iloilo City's rise as a top food tourism destination. By simplifying payments and empowering businesses, we're making it easier for travelers to discover the exceptional flavors of this gastronomic paradise.


Travel agencies and tour operators: it's time to embrace the future of tourism. Integrate PayMongo today and give your customers stress-free, memorable experiences. Together, let's showcase the best of Iloilo's culinary heritage to the world!
